Root cause: .app-shell was the only element sized from the VISUAL viewport (inline script -> --app-100vh) while .tabbar/.sheet-wrap/.toast-host are position:fixed on the LAYOUT viewport. Reproduced in Chrome: spoofed visualViewport.height=475 + resize collapsed the shell to 475px with the bar still at 744 (269px dead band) and did not recover without a resize event -- explains both wrong spacing and shifting. Fix: removed the inline script; .app-shell/.app-loading are position:fixed;inset:0 (same ICB as the fixed bar); overscroll-behavior-y:contain on .app-scroll; new --bottom-gutter token (8px) shared by TabBar + Sheet + --tabbar-h; Toast bottom un-hardcoded to calc(var(--tabbar-h)+var(--sp-3)). 80 tests pass, build succeeds.
